- `src/app/features/search/search.component.html`
- `src/app/features/search/search.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/search/search.component.scss`

## Hardcoded Strings Found & Replaced

| Location | Hardcoded Value | Translation Key |

| HTML h1 | "Legal Search" | `search.page_title` |
| HTML p | "Search documents, laws, cases..." | `search.page_subtitle` |
| HTML input [placeholder] | "Search for laws, cases, clauses..." | `search.input_placeholder` |
| HTML input [aria-label] | "Search legal documents, laws, and cases" | `search.input_aria` |
| HTML button [aria-label] | 'Searching' / 'Search' | `search.btn_searching` / `search.btn_search` |
| HTML h3 (empty state) | "Semantic Legal Search" | `search.welcome_title` |
| HTML p (empty state) | "Search across your documents..." | `search.welcome_desc` |
| HTML span (meta) | "results for" | `search.meta_results` |
| HTML span (relevance) | "Relevance" | `search.relevance` |
| HTML h3 (no results) | "No results found" | `search.no_results_title` |
| HTML p (no results) | "Try different keywords..." | `search.no_results_desc` |
| TS searchTypes labels | 'Hybrid', 'Semantic AI', 'Keyword' | `search.type.hybrid`, `search.type.semantic`, `search.type.keyword` |

## Items NOT Translated (Correct Per Rules)
- `suggestedSearches` array — these are example search queries (content, not UI)
- `result.resultType | titlecase` — backend enum display value
- `result.title`, `result.excerpt` — search result content
- `result.relevanceScore` — numeric data
- `formatDate()` output — formatted data

## RTL Fix Applied
- `search.component.scss`: `.search-bar__icon` `margin-right: 12px` → `margin-inline-end: 12px` (×2 including responsive override at 360px breakpoint)
- Root cause: physical directional property `margin-right` does not flip in RTL; logical property `margin-inline-end` does.

## Search Logic: UNTOUCHED
- `doSearch()`, `onSearch()`, `onKeydown()` — no changes
- `MockService.search()` — no changes
- Signals: `query`, `results`, `loading`, `total`, `searchType`, `searchTime`, `hasSearched` — no changes
- Router/query param handling — no changes
